title: Unit Event — Find A Way Out — Episode2 Where The Legend Began

meta.Event Outline: Tis the season to be jolly and Vivid BAD SQUAD is all gathered at Weekend Garage. They discuss performing at the live house where RADder debuted, but Akito seems to have some history with said venue...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, why is this live house considered sacred?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Because Crawl Green is where RADder debuted!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I heard from others that RADder was so good that they made the entire place shake. And they were just high schoolers! You wouldn't have believed it was a brand new team.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: After that event, everybody in and around this city knew who RADder was...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, that's amazing...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: However, the owner personally checks all the music beforehand.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Only the people that get the okay actually receive the privilege of performing there. It's kinda similar to COL.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Yeah, and it's not easy.
We've tried a few times in the past but still haven't been allowed to perform there yet.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: So, everyone around here, especially people who look up to RADder or are chasing after them, sees that place as a sort of holy site! Right, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's true...

rows.Speaker: EVER Member B
rows.Line: You've performed there before, right, Tono?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, a few times.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Wait, seriously?! Does that mean if we tell that owner you're with us...?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: No, making an appearance there is one thing, but hosting an event is an entirely different story.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: We'll have to establish a good record of putting on quality events before we can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A good record...
I guess two successful events won't be enough, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But we have the skills and talent necessary to perform there.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Which is why I've been negotiating with the owner ever since our last event ended.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So that's what you've been up to...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I did decide to chase after the same dream with all of you, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But that sounds like a lot of work...
As nice as the owner of that place is, he can be pretty stubborn.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I still haven't gotten him to say okay yet, but I have a good feeling based on how our talks have been going...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I told him, “We're going to put on an event that's even better and more packed than the one RADder put on when they debuted!”

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Also, I'm sure we can tip the odds in our favor by showing him a video of our last event.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: That's pretty bold of you, Tono...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, but I like it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We gotta be willing to take chances if we're actually gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd like to perform there too...!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Yeah, us too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Us. Performing there...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, nothing...
I'm all for it too.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
It'd be great to do a show there.
I've been wanting to for a really long time now!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Alright, it sounds like we're in agreement. I'll go show him a video of our last event and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Actually, Arata...
Would you mind if I tagged along?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've known the owner since I was little, so I should be able to help convince him...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, that'd be great.
Then, I'll let you know next time I go to visit him.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good luck, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can count on me!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Okay, see you all later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See you guys!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our after party sort of turned into a planning meeting for our next event...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, but it seemed natural for us to do that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, what are you two doing after this?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to start setting up all the Christmas stuff, so Kohane and I are gonna stay a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I should get home soon.
We're having our Christmas party today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?! Already?!
Isn't it a little soon for that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My dad's schedule is usually fully booked with performances during the holiday season, so we prefer to celebrate early when we can all gather.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I see.
I guess it is a busy time of year.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What about you, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm heading home. I still need to do my daily training and have to make up for the time I lost to our after party.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're going to practice after this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I get kinda antsy if I don't follow my usual routine.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's getting dark, so be careful, okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I will. Anyway, later.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Our Christmas sale is underway!
Please stop by to have a look!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Oh, congratulations! First prize is a pair of all-expenses-paid vacation passes! Please enjoy your trip!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Crawl Green, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I really wasn't expecting that name to come up...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, it's only natural since we're trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND. I mean...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Performing there was a big goal for me...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, things are different this time. I won't drag its name through the mud this time.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I have them now...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And our next event's going to be another good one.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (So, I've gotta spend as much time as I can getting ready for it...)
